segments.contextBefore: Prepare the body of the request with a name and a hash of the software that you want to notarize, as well as optional information about how to notify you when notarization completes.
segments.contextAfter:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import hashlib

with open("OvernightTextEditor_11.6.8.zip", "rb") as file:
    hash = hashlib.sha256()
    hash.update(file.read())
    sha256 = hash.hexdigest()

body = {
    "submissionName": "OvernightTextEditor_11.6.8.zip",
    "sha256": sha256,
    "notifications": [{"channel": "webhook", "target": "https://example.com" }]
}
```

segments.contextBefore: Use the `attributes` object that appears in the response from the [`Submit Software`](submit-software.md) call to upload your software to Amazon S3.
segments.contextAfter:
```python
import boto3

aws_info = output["data"]["attributes"]
bucket = aws_info["bucket"]
key = aws_info["object"]
sub_id = output["data"]["id"]

s3 = boto3.client(
         "s3",
         aws_access_key_id=aws_info["awsAccessKeyId"],
         aws_secret_access_key=aws_info["awsSecretAccessKey"],
         aws_session_token=aws_info["awsSessionToken"],
         config=Config(s3={"use_accelerate_endpoint": True})
)

resp = s3.upload_file("OvernightTextEditor_11.6.8.zip", bucket, key)
```
